comment: Pokermon 3.2.1 -> 3.9.1 batch 5 (Plans/MICATRO_MODS_UPGRADES.md section 3): which of 3.9.1's static-data changes to EXISTING jokers we take.
Read by tools/micatro/gen_pokermon_391_overlay.mjs, which writes micatro/mods/pokermon/data391.js. Never hand-edit data391.js: edit this file and regenerate.

take_always: pool / shop / sticker statics the engine reads with the same meaning whatever the joker does (rarity, cost, Perishable / Eternal eligibility, enhancement gates), and the Steamodded attributes 3.9.1 jokers declare (inert until 3.9.1 content draws from attribute pools). Taken for every existing joker.

take: per joker, the config paths and compat flags whose 3.9.1 value is read by OUR ported (3.2.1) logic with the same meaning: the joker's 3.9.1 calculate is a refactor of the 3.2.1 one (namespaces, SMODS.scale_card, return-table shape), not a rework.

reasons: why a joker's other changes wait (a rework: its upstream logic changed with the numbers). Every value change of a config key both versions have, and every blueprint_compat flip, must be taken or have a reason here, or the generator fails.
sprite_hold: jokers that keep their 3.2.1 sprite (and sheet).

reasons.spearow: rework (3.6.0 Spearow line): counts cards drawn instead of scored, new evo_rqmt / triggers
reasons.fearow: rework (Spearow line): cards drawn + a discard, add/remove_from_deck
reasons.pikachu: rework: money threshold + Mult, no cash-out $
reasons.raichu: rework: money count / threshold + Mult (and Megas X / Y)
reasons.sandshrew: rework: the Glass-restore half was removed
reasons.sandslash: rework: Glass limit / restore replaced by a 1 in 3
reasons.golbat: rework (Zubat line): new Golbat effect, evo_rqmt 20 -> 16
reasons.oddish: rework: three outcomes (mult1) instead of two
reasons.mega_kangaskhan: 3.9.1 adds a not-context.blueprint guard with the flag: our port has no guard (Blueprint would copy the consumable effect)
reasons.victreebel: rework: round retriggers (retrigger_max) with the chip change
reasons.koffing: rework: Volatile Left + Mult, evolves in 2 rounds
reasons.magmar: rework: the once-per-round remove_triggered flag is gone (scales every first single discard)
reasons.glaceon: rework (Eevee line): retriggers instead of the 1 in 4
reasons.leafeon: rework (Eevee line): no more hand size
reasons.qwilfish: Hazard layer rework (batch 10): hazard_level replaces the per-joker hazard ratio
reasons.corsola: rework: tally replaced by scaling Mult
reasons.smeargle: rework: get_copy replaces the copy_pos machinery
reasons.kricketune: calculate changed (a consumable-room check gates the Item)
reasons.vanillite: rework with the flag (scale_card / destroy rewrite; the line's Blueprint behaviour changes)
reasons.vikavolt: rework: no self-count, the +Mult half was removed
reasons.ursaluna: calculate changed (the Item's edition is a random aura edition, not Polychrome)
reasons.mega_steelix: rework: Stone cards held instead of Diamonds $

sprite_hold.unown: 3.9.1 redrew Unown's card for the Unown rework (another frame and badge); our Unown is the 3.2.1 one
